<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barpos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return min(rs),min(cs)
def check(r): return bool(r.get('level_completed') or r.get('run_complete') or r.get('done'))
def path_to(tr,tc):
    r,c=barpos(); seq=[]
    while (r,c)!=(tr,tc):
        if r<tr: seq.append('DOWN'); r+=4
        elif r>tr: seq.append('UP'); r-=4
        elif c<tc: seq.append('RIGHT'); c+=4
        else: seq.append('LEFT'); c-=4
    return seq
rows=[20,16,24,12,28,32,40,44]; cols=[0,4,8,12,16,20,24,28,32,36,40,44]
targets=[(tr,tc) for tr in rows for tc in cols]
# order by proximity to current
p0=barpos()
targets.sort(key=lambda t:(abs(t[0]-p0[0])+abs(t[1]-p0[1])))
print('start',p0)
acts=0
for (tr,tc) in targets:
    if acts>55: print('cap reached at',barpos()); break
    seq=path_to(tr,tc)
    r=action(seq) if seq else action(['SPACE'])
    acts+=max(1,len(seq))
    if r.get('game_over'): print('GO at',(tr,tc),'now',barpos()); continue
    if check(r): print('WIN at',(tr,tc)); break
print('final',barpos(),'state',last_action_result.get('state'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
